summary: Shows a garden of trees, one tile per completed focus session, with the total tree count and focused minutes.
purpose: Reward finished focus sessions with a visible record.
why: Likely reason: a visible garden makes past focus work feel rewarding.
how: 1) Defines five tree types, each with a name, color and symbol. 2) Adds up the minutes of all sessions. 3) Shows the count and total in the header. 4) Draws one tile per session with its tree name, symbol and length. 5) Shows a message when there are no sessions.
inputs: A list of focus sessions passed in by the parent, each with an id, a length in minutes, and a tree type.
outputs: Visual output only. Nothing is saved or changed.
risks: Unknown tree types fall back to the pine look. The color values are defined but not applied to the tiles.
debug: If a tree shows the wrong symbol, check the tree type stored on that session. If totals are off, check the minutes stored on each session. If the empty message shows wrongly, check the list passed in.
